prep.summary:
Core functionality is complete and the build is stable. The full test suite previously passed with 186 tests and 3 skips; Ruff and `git diff --check` were clean. Completed work includes search rebuilding, tenant isolation, unique document indexing, webhook retries, centralized context initialization, dependency updates, UTF-8 CSV export, and major search-performance optimization. The 10,000-document search benchmark improved from a 16.73-second median to 2.41 seconds.

Billing cleanup is also complete. `build_invoice_lines` now has a concrete list return type, `calculate_totals` explicitly converts discounts to `Decimal` while preserving percentage behavior, and ledger posting uses timezone-aware UTC timestamps rather than deprecated `datetime.utcnow()`. Additional typing changes to `reverse_entry` and `account_balance` were considered unnecessary and intentionally skipped. The billing suite passed twice; the latest run had 34 passing tests in 0.52 seconds, and the prior UTC deprecation warning is gone.

The latest operator note was only a typo correction and did not change the intended requirements. A final `git diff --stat` showed three files changed with 41 annotation lines added, and `git diff --check` found no whitespace errors. No blockers are known. The documentation-page threshold remains outstanding but unchanged. Speculative ideas—event-driven exports, richer tax snapshots, immutable audit streams, tax property tests, bulk ledger dry runs, and structured worker retry reasons—require no action at this time.
